purpose: Independent preregistered precise gyro-propagation and causal braking hypothesis; unqualified and not selected in firmware
baseline: Original 28 fixtures and all acceptance checks retained without exclusions or threshold changes
orientation: 300 stable samples at 100 Hz under explicit initial stationary alignment prior; normalize mean gravity; arbitrary heading cancels in recentered grip; exact quaternion exponential from gyro minus measured initial gyro bias thereafter
acceleration_correction_policy: None after initial alignment. In particular, do not learn sustained translation as tilt during motion or coast. This is not drift-free and does not learn accelerometer bias.
velocity: Integrate every compensated acceleration sample with actual near-nominal source dt; no onset threshold, no velocity leak and no rest reset from acceleration quietness alone
braking: Opposing acceleration exceeding 0.05 m/s^2 at prior speed >=0.02 m/s latches braking. Positive work with acceleration >0.2 m/s^2 clears the latch, allowing reversal. Only a brake latch followed by speed <=0.01 m/s and residual acceleration <=0.12 m/s^2 for 4 samples supplies a stop prior. Known coast above the pointer deadband is retained.
pointer_rationale: Twice the original bench gain tests whether quantization latency meets the unchanged 80 ms onset bound. Velocity accuracy thresholds and all original metrics are unchanged. This is a new explicit control parameter, not a comparator correction.
safety_reference: The same actual pinned Fusion C, settings and startup/overrange/acceleration-recovery gates remain in the benchmark adapter. Fusion orientation is not used by the new compensation observer. No invented recovery flags.
reset: Data discontinuity/nonfinite/overrange restarts alignment. Permission loss clears velocity/carry/arming while gyro propagation may continue. Explicit recenter supplies a stationary prior and freezes the grip frame.
known_risks: Initial rest and later stop inference are assumptions, not measured velocity truth
Bias introduced during movement can still accumulate
Gyro-only propagation can drift over long sessions
A very slow coast below the output deadband is observationally ambiguous with stop
Double precision trigonometric cost on the MCU is unmeasured
No device performance or human usability is inferred from this host experiment
execution_policy: Hash complete new source, parameters, runner and unchanged baseline inputs before any new-candidate execution. Preserve the first result and every failed case. No tuning after observing this preregistered run. Integration requires separate review and real capture evidence.
